{

    {
      "login": "hebasto",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK on fixing the Windows wrapper execution behavior; noted MSVCRT workarounds would become unnecessary once #33593 merged"
    },
    {

    },
    {

      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "commented on commit attribution style regarding AI policy"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3998822372",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "MSVCRT builds report an unhelpful 'Invalid argument' error instead of 'No such file or directory' when the target executable is missing",
      "quote": "When the target executable is missing, the error the user sees differs between runtimes: MSVCRT: Error: execvp failed to execute '...\\bitcoind': Invalid argument",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer withdrew the concern in c:5714437254 after #33593 dropped MSVCRT support, and author dropped the workaround commit in r:5296577726",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4087771863", "r:5296577726"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5714437254",
      "status_by_quote": "My own comment above about mapping EINVAL to ENOENT goes away with it, for the same reason."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3894313979",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "asks whether the runtime difference in error codes between MSVCRT and UCRT is documented elsewhere",
      "quote": "Checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/c-runtime-library/reference/spawnvp-wspawnvp?view=msvc-170 but this difference in error codes between runtimes is not documented there. Is it admitted elsewhere?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it was only observed in CI and added tests/comments; reviewer accepted in rc:3982725901",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3964034373", "rc:3970607586"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3982725901",
      "status_by_quote": "Impressive testing by @ryan8or. ^^ (https://github.com/ryanofsky/bitcoin/actions/runs/34367754505)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3982715149",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "asks why interface_gui.py is skipped on vcpkg builds instead of fixing QT_PLUGIN_PATH to make it run",
      "quote": "So why would you be changing the functional test to skip something which should be working?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that fixing bitcoin-qt execution is better handled in a separate PR and improved documentation in the meantime",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4087690228"],
      "other_replies": ["rc:3983276170"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4087690228",
      "status_by_quote": "I think this is probably better to address in a separate pr since this PR is supposed be a bitcoin.exe bugfix, not change the way bitcoin-qt.exe is run."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5714437254",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "drop the MSVCRT workaround commit 68ae4a0f upon rebasing on #33593 while keeping generic errno handling commit 2b877984",
      "quote": "Suggestion for the rebase on #33593: drop 68ae4a0f, keep 2b877984. They read as one story, but only the first one is MSVCRT-specific.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the MSVCRT workaround commit in r:5296577726",
      "author_replies": ["r:5296577726"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5296577726",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks dropped 68ae4a0f84b12587b9e2b53d3e306460fad4244a workaround."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5046136756",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK.",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5066222814",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK 30ae05a21bdb30e63400385cf6d9dfd87dccfc70",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review of the rebased branch with MSVCRT workaround commit dropped",
      "id": "r:5296577726"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added questions and suggestions from hodlinator and cyb3ralbert under schema 2 rules. cyb3ralbert's objection on MSVCRT error formatting was withdrawn and marked accepted after #33593 removed MSVCRT support and the author dropped the workaround commit."
}
